descriptionPlain: Mobileye is looking for a passionate and experienced System Architect to lead the definition and evolution of validation methodologies for complex multidisciplinary systems. In this role, you will combine deep system-level understanding with extensive validation expertise to drive platform validation strategies, identify technical risks, influence architectural decisions, and ensure the quality, robustness, and reliability of our products throughout the development lifecycle.
description: Mobileye is looking for a passionate and experienced System Architect to lead the definition and evolution of validation methodologies for complex multidisciplinary systems. In this role, you will combine deep system-level understanding with extensive validation expertise to drive platform validation strategies, identify technical risks, influence architectural decisions, and ensure the quality, robustness, and reliability of our products throughout the development lifecycle.

lists.text: What will your job look like?
lists.content:
• Develop a deep understanding of the system architecture and its implementation across all platform features and domains.
  • Define, own, and drive feature-level and platform-level validation strategies, leveraging positive, negative, boundary, fault-injection, robustness, integration, and architectural validation methodologies to ensure comprehensive system verification and risk mitigation.
  • Derive and define platform-level validation requirements, methodologies, coverage models, validation criteria, and acceptance criteria that complement and extend existing system requirements.
  • Identify validation gaps, testability challenges, architectural weaknesses, and technical risks early in the development lifecycle.
  • Review platform architecture and design decisions, providing validation-driven feedback to improve quality, reliability, robustness, and testability.
  • Influence architectural decisions through validation findings, root-cause investigations, technical analysis, and data-driven recommendations.
  • Lead root-cause analysis of complex system-level issues and drive resolution across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Serve as the technical focal point for validation-related architectural discussions, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with system architects, developers, and validation engineers to ensure validation considerations are integrated throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Drive continuous improvement of validation methodologies, tools, processes, and coverage across the platform.

• 7+ years of experience as a System Architect, Systems Engineer, or similar technical leadership role in a multidisciplinary environment. 
  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience leading system-level validation activities, defining validation methodologies, validation strategies, coverage models, and verification approaches for complex products.
  • Proven experience in investigating complex system-level issues, performing root cause analysis, and driving resolution across multiple engineering domains.
  • Experience working closely with system architects and influencing design decisions through validation insights and technical recommendations.
  • Strong systems thinking with the ability to understand complex interactions and the propagation of effects across an entire system.
  • Proven ability to analyze complex architectures and identify risks, gaps, weaknesses, and opportunities for improved validation coverage.
  • B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

descriptionPlain:

We are looking for a Technical Product Manager to own cloud and data services used by  our internal teams and external customers, alongside a new generation of AI-native, agentic products that bring Mobileye's proprietary knowledge and self-service tooling directly to engineers.
This is a hands-on technical product role, but not only that. You'll own roadmap, requirements, and cross-functional execution while staying close to the technology itself. Just as importantly, you can zoom out to shape the high-level product story — the vision and the “why” that align stakeholders and give the work direction. As we increasingly integrate AI into our products, we need a PM who learns fast and turns ideas into working products.
You'll shape how a sophisticated, multi-petabyte data and cloud ecosystem evolves, influencing how Mobileye's platforms are built internally and how leading global OEMs consume our data and services. It's a rare seat at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data delivery, and applied GenAI, on products that directly support the future of autonomous mobility.
This is a full-time, 12-month position covering a maternity leave, with potential for extension based on business needs.

descriptionPlain:
At Mentee Robotics, we are redefining humanoid automation with an AI-first approach - combining perception, reasoning, and dexterous manipulation into fully autonomous systems that continuously learn and adapt.
We are now expanding with a new robotics Engineering center in China, working hand-in-hand with our engineering teams in headquarters. Its mission: to rapidly develop our next-generation full-size humanoid and bring it to life - a walking, working platform that becomes the foundation of our next generation of products. This is a small, senior, hands-on team where speed of iteration is the core value.
We are looking for a Testing & Validation Engineer to own quality across the humanoid program: from joint-level dyno and life testing to full-system benchmarking and shipment readiness before delivery to headquarters. You define what 'done' means - for every component and for the robot.

lists.content:
• A test engineer with strong mechatronics intuition - you understand what you are measuring
  • Structured and data-driven, but pragmatic about what a prototype actually needs
  • Comfortable being the gatekeeper

• Build and operate the joint test infrastructure: dyno setups for torque, speed, efficiency, thermal, and life testing of actuator modules
  • Define and execute component-level verification for boards, batteries, harnesses, and sensors with the responsible engineers
  • Own integration verification at every stage: leg on bench, robot on gantry, free-standing, walking
  • Define and run full-system performance benchmarking (payload, speed, endurance, repeatability) and reliability assessment
  • Build the acceptance criteria and shipment-readiness process for every robot and subsystem delivered to headquarters
  • Develop test automation (Python) and maintain traceable test records tied to hardware and firmware revisions
  • Feed structured failure analysis back into design - you close the iteration loop

• B.Sc. in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering
  • 5+ years in testing and validation of electromechanical systems: robotics, automotive, or automation
  • Hands-on experience building test rigs and instrumentation (torque sensors, current probes, thermal measurement, data acquisition)
  • Strong data analysis skills; Python proficiency for test automation and reporting
  • Experience in defining verification plans, acceptance criteria, and reliability/life test programs
  • Fluent English for cross-site collaboration with headquarters

• Experience at humanoid/robot companies, cobot firms, or automotive
  • Actuator/servo dyno testing experience
  • Familiarity with HIL testing and firmware validation
  • Exposure to safety and compliance standards for robotics

description:
We are looking for a highly organized and service-oriented Travel Coordinator to join our Operations Services team.

This is a unique opportunity to take ownership of the company's end-to-end travel operations and become a key point of contact for employees across the organization.
The role offers a high level of independence, broad exposure to internal stakeholders and external partners, and the ability to make a real impact on the employee travel experience.
It is an excellent position for someone who enjoys managing complex processes, solving challenges, and continuously learning in a dynamic environment.
You will have the opportunity to develop expertise in global travel operations, vendor management, budgeting, and employee support while working as part of a collaborative and professional team.

  • Manage relationships and agreements with hotels, car rental providers, and other travel suppliers.

  • Support employees throughout the travel process and provide timely assistance when travel-related issues arise.
